title: RAGMark: A Comprehensive Framework for Benchmarking Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.05760v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present RAGMark, a modular benchmarking framework for advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems targeting small-scale multi-GPU environments. RAGMark evaluates diverse RAG components, including retrievers, vector databases, prompt-processing methods, and generator models, while collecting detailed per-stage metrics such as latency, GPU utilization, memory consumption, power usage, time to first token (TTFT), throughput, and answer quality. The framework is highly extensible, separating RAG stages, timing, and resource monitoring into modular components, and is designed to efficiently sweep large configuration spaces while minimizing repeated model and database initialization overhead. Using RAGMark, we characterize five RAG workloads on open-domain QA datasets across varying retrieval depths, model scales, reranking, compression methods, and vector database configurations. translated_abstract: 我们提出了 RAGMark，一个面向小型多 GPU 环境的先进检索增强生成（RAG）系统的模块化基准测试框架。RAGMark 评估多样的 RAG 组件，包括检索器、向量数据库、提示词处理方法和生成模型，同时收集详细的分阶段指标，如延迟、GPU 利用率、内存消耗、功耗、首 token 生成时间（TTFT）、吞吐量和答案质量。该框架具有高度可扩展性，将 RAG 各阶段、计时和资源监控分离为模块化组件，并旨在高效扫描大型配置空间的同时，最大限度地减少重复的模型和数据库初始化开销。利用 RAGMark，我们在开放域问答数据集上对不同检索深度、模型规模、重排序、压缩方法和向量数据库配置下的五种 RAG 工作负载进行了特征分析。我们表明，虽然自回归生成占主导……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了 RAGMark，一个面向小型多 GPU 环境的模块化基准测试框架，能够全面评估 RAG 系统各组件（检索器、向量数据库、提示处理方法、生成模型）在延迟、资源消耗和答案质量等多维指标下的表现。
en_tdlr: RAGMark is a modular benchmarking framework for comprehensively evaluating RAG system components across latency, resource consumption, and answer quality metrics in small-scale multi-GPU environments.
